user_scope: Four extra older ES years, 2021–2026, zero incremental data cost; implement actual Claude recommendations 1–4.

data.source: Original GLBX.MDP3 OHLCV-1s ES.FUT, exact dated quarterly outrights, no adjusted continuous prices.
data.resolution: One-second OHLCV, NOT bid/ask TBBO or a known true intrasecond tick path.
data.roll: Existing causal prior-session-volume rule, forward maturity only; freeze price-only schedule before labels. Five same-contract full warm-up sessions.
data.calendar: Preserve exact native ES calendar/session/flatten where available; older exchange holidays/early closes must be verified before older labels.
data.price_gate: Authenticated get_cost exact0USD immediately before EVERY monthly request; positive or error stops without that data request.
data.quality: Preserve vendor degraded flags, including known28Nov2025; no silent outcome-based exclusion.
data.acquisition: Known Nov2025–Oct2026 months first, then Nov2021–Oct2025; raw prices only, sealed outcomes remain uncomputed.

periods.sealed_label_rule: No labels/outcomes until source, model coefficients/preprocessing, calibrator and rule are frozen; metadata/prices may be audited.
periods.known_year_status: Used repeatedly for strategy/model selection; never fresh OOS.
periods.older_year_status: Held out within this newly registered ML study; no claim of universal historical data independence.

review.accepted_specs: Actual Claude confirmation of one-second-end decisions and symmetric >=2-second market fills, 21 November 2026; no private session metadata published.
critical_conditions: Strategy-only check on development years only

candidate.strategy_reference: ES C28.03 funded EMA20, one definition; no near-duplicate EMA22/Eval/Funded rows.
candidate.sequence: Band → opposite band → first EMA20 return; latest band determines side; consume first return regardless of later eligibility.
candidate.overlap: Also independent shadow candidate while base position open; base_was_flat flag retained, never multiply one setup across accounts.
candidate.normal_entry_and_flatten_cutoff: 15:09 strictly; native early close/flatten overrides retained.
candidate.center: EMA20 forming from prior committed 5-minute EMA and current minute close.
candidate.ATR: Wilder10, initial mean10 TR; first bar each day H−L; subsequent TR includes prior close.
candidate.entry: Market fill at first observed second interval Open at least2seconds after decision. It must precede native flatten. Report missing intervals/delays; never invent a bar.
candidate.stop: Decision-end EMA20 − side×2.15formingATR10, outward0.25tick; fixed after decision.
candidate.news: Omitted consistently for research candidate inventory only; no historical SI/news invented. This is not provider-compliant payout simulation.
candidate.other_logic: No extra filters, direction/parameter searches or changed session rules.
candidate.reconstruction: O-H-L-C and O-L-H-C are uncertainty scenarios only. Both include Open and Close; forming5min range updated in scenario order. Carry all unresolved finite sequence states across seconds, deduplicated without outcome information.
candidate.consensus: A candidate only if all paths/states agree in direction and second. Ambiguous first returns count as missing in native acceptance, never pick the profitable path.
candidate.decision: At second interval END, using only information available then; stop and five features fixed there. No retrospective trade at an earlier intrasecond EMA touch.
candidate.spread: Fill trade-price proxy plus one adverse tick for buy, minus one for sell. This is an explicit conservative spread approximation, independent of later stress.

labels.primary: One-second approximation of original C28.03 moving BB/OR/stop decisions with >=2s market-fill latency. Not native tick labels.
labels.BB: 20-value forming population BB1.75 with0.75tick offset; target touch during a second is reconstructed without claiming the actual path. Decision at secondEND.
labels.OR: Fixed first60min high/low afterminute60; actualentry favorable-distance guard>=1tick. Touch triggers an exit intent, NOT fillatlevel.
labels.priority: If stop and any target touch within same second, stop wins. Once an exit intent exists, preserve it; no later outcome-based replacement.
labels.flatten: At native flatten time an exit intent is generated, then first observed secondOpen >=flatten+2s, with adverse spread; no new entries at/afterflatten.
labels.secondary: No bracket-rule or separate label search in this one reconstruction; original movingtarget label is primary.
labels.exit: All stop/BB/OR market exits fill first observed secondOpen >= exitdecisionEND+2s, with adverse spread tick. No guaranteed stop/target-price fills.
labels.risk_causality: Decision quote proxy is decisionClose+side×1spreadtick; never use later actual entryprice to select features/size/risk.

mandatory_known_year_approximation_accep.reference: 347 unique native C28.03 candidates on same known242 sessions, source hashes checked.
mandatory_known_year_approximation_accep.match: Same contract, Chicago date and side. All pairs within300s sorted by(abs time difference,native signal ns,coarse signal ns); take each native/coarse candidate at most once. No outcomes used.
also_report: Signed mean and mean absolute net-R error
mandatory_known_year_approximation_accep.failure_action: End bar-reconstruction route after this one-second attempt; no older labels/training, no relaxed thresholds. Consult actual Claude on the final result.
mandatory_known_year_approximation_accep.ambiguous_cases: Count as unmatched, included in denominator; do not prune native reference to easy cases.

feature_rules: Decision-second END only. CurrentsecondOHLC is then known. Planned risk uses decision quoteproxy, not future fill. ORfeature eligibility uses decisionquoteproxy; actualentryguard only for later exit label. Slope and relvol from completed5min bars. No intrasecond backdating, future highs/lows/MFE or SI-history invention.

models.calibration: Training-only expanding chronological cross-predictions, whole-session gap and label-end purge. a=unrestricted training mean(y), b=OLS slope of y on centered cross-prediction clipped[0,1]. Prediction=a+b×(raw−mean(cross-predictions)).
models.gate: Omit only if calibrated expected net-R<0; if a<=0, gate inactive, explicitly reported.
models.preprocessing: Fit scaler/imputation only on each training subset; no sealed covariate-assisted fitting.
models.forward_shadow: Frozen portable model/rule; record forecast before outcome; no trading changes. Deployment requires subsequent native gate/account replay and forward evidence.

evaluation.primary_final: Ridge Spearman(prediction,stressNetR), one-sided session-level conditional permutation at alpha0.05; fixed boosting descriptive secondary, not selection winner.
evaluation.conditional_permutation: 1999 permutations,seed20261121; permute whole ordered daily outcome vectors within calendar-quarter and same daily candidate-count strata, report immovable fraction.
evaluation.uncertainty: 1999 moving5-session blocks for descriptive confidence intervals; report final test count, do not assert500 cases without counting.
also_report: Mean omitted and taken stress net-R
No claim of payout gain without native policy/account rerun

supersedes_reconstruction_only: Minute-close v1 failed recall57.64%,precision68.73%; old FAIL/source/data retained. No older labels or fits generated.
